answer: Bind voting and earning weight strictly to posted stake at a fixed linear rate, with no per-identity free allotment: one locked unit of the kernel asset buys exactly one unit of influence however the staker is partitioned. Splitting capital across a dune of fake identities yields the same total weight as holding it in one — fragmentation is influence-neutral. To rise above the honest tide an attacker must post genuinely more collateral, not more names; cost scales with influence bought, not identities minted.
